en: Black-and-white vintage postcard showing a quiet tree-lined street bordered by late 19th–early 20th century townhouses. On the right is a more prominent building with an ornate corner tower-like roof and arched windows, likely the local post office. A few pedestrians, including a child in short trousers and adults in period dress, walk along the street. Printed red text in German at the top identifies the town, region, and street with the post office.
